name: Ducati 750 Sport / 750SS (bevel)
engine: 748 cc air-cooled bevel-drive V-twin, desmo on the SS, two carbs
intro: Ducati's round-case bevel twins. Very valuable now, with bevel-drive cams and parts best sourced from specialists.

H: The bevel-drive cams are set with shims and need patience. Check the bevel gear backlash and the desmo shims before you run it hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
